import_conversion_validation.method: Measured imported Hand_L global rest times Blender Hand_L inverse, then checked all 54 independent rests; no assumed axis swizzle.

readiness.shape: Accepted natural-proportion hand shape and continuous wrist finish for the scoped desktop character integration; no new geometry in promotion.
readiness.animation_retarget: 14 clips, 5 finger poses, 54 rests and exact imported channel coverage verified. 1974 source key times/106596 bone comparisons pass; 52 sampled proper-crossing probes pass with no new-region folds. Four inherited old-forearm extreme-wrist flags remain.
readiness.finish: Original procedural 2048x1024 PBR accepted after reviewed native representatives; actual avatar shader normal/roughness/AO bindings verified. Final imported GLB three-prop native sequence completed 102/102 frames.
readiness.runtime: Six real Production/Selection composed-transition runs passed at 15/30/60 Hz. Production integration acceptance is scoped to these local Godot 4.6.3 tests and reviewed native character footage, not custom 4.8 or full source-water world performance.
acceptance_boundaries: Custom NVIDIA Godot 4.8 and target Windows/NVIDIA hardware were not tested.

The source-water plus finished-avatar native attempts source-water-avatar-finish-01 and source-water-avatar-finish-360-02 both ended with SIGKILL/exit -9. They did not pass and are not included as successful combined-world evidence.
The 102-frame successful character sequence uses the declared controlled constant-water fixture, not the unchanged full source-water shader/world combination.
Four inherited protected-forearm extreme-wrist stress flags remain; unrelated steep-slope/seam foot penetration, broad stylized torso/shoulders and simple procedural face remain.

Native capture reports structural/material results, not automated visual acceptance. Representative native skin views were manually reviewed; full continuous self-contact and every camera/pose are not claimed.
The packed Blend is independently editable. Ordinary Blender glTF export is not proven representation-identical; the stopped compact-export experiment is not a supported turnkey generator.

acceptance_provenance.change_scope: Only acceptance/readiness/provenance metadata. Model, skeleton, raw Blender definitions, contact frames, poses and import conversion remain identical to the audited diagnostic contract.
